In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''transport''' was assigned to transport prisoner [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgist]] [[Ketrian Altronel]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[Hargeeva]]. En route, the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was [[Capture of an Imperial transport|captured]] by [[Uskgarv's pirates]].
